title: 第928章 若是技痒尽可上前第927章 撕破脸皮发难
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 柳厉再次出声暴喝，“目无尊卑，三番五次无视联盟律法，你真当这联盟议事大殿，是你可以随意撒野的地方吗？”
“先是不敬执法长老，后又出言不逊亵渎盟主，如今，更是公然诋毁联盟高层！”
“按照联盟律法，单凭这几条，就足以将你打入执法堂，废去丹田，斩除兽契，永世不得翻身！”
夜玄眸子眯成细缝，毫不相让，“那你可以试试。”
柳厉闻声不再多言，抬脚猛然一震！
殿中众联盟高层只觉眼前一花，下一瞬，柳厉与夜玄竟齐齐消失不见。
原地，只留下一片微微扭曲的空间涟漪。
甲级御兽师天赋·十度空间，执法堂柳厉长老的天赋…
浩瀚的银色空间中，夜玄与柳厉凭空出现。
空间无边无际，脚下是银白色的平面，像是一面巨大明镜，倒映着两人身影。
夜玄环顾四周，目光中闪过一丝意外：“这是…甲级御兽师天赋十度空间？”
“夜圣子倒是慧眼识精。”
柳厉独眼中带着几分志在必得，“本尊倒要看看，你这八阶御兽师，究竟有多少水分。”
他抬手一挥，青光暴涨，一道庞大的身影在他身前凝聚成型。
现身场地的，为一头青色巨鹿，体型足有数丈高，一对鹿角冲天，如同两柄倒插利剑，角尖泛着幽幽寒光。
巨鹿头顶，一朵紫红色花苞含苞待放。
八阶七星混种圣兽·曼陀罗鹿君，天赋根深蒂固、巨木甲胄。
曼陀罗鹿君，一种实力不错的圣兽妖宠。
天赋根深蒂固，只要脚踩大地，即可获取源源不断的精纯灵力，用于修复自身。
混种天赋巨木甲胄，更是赐予其无与伦比的防御能力。
“夜圣子，你方才在大殿上口出狂言，如今在这十度空间中，境界受到压制，本尊倒要看看，你还能狂到几时。”
柳厉抬手一拍曼陀罗鹿君，鹿君心有灵犀，头顶紫红色花苞骤然绽放！
花苞层层舒展，如同盛开的妖异莲花，从中喷涌出大量浓稠的紫色雾气。
雾气如同活物翻滚涌动，铺天盖地地朝夜玄涌去！
雾气所过，银白色空间都被染上一层淡紫，空气中弥漫着一股甜腻而危险的气息。
兽技·麻毒。
十度空间封闭难破，雾气无处消散。
被困在里面的敌人，将会一点点被蚕食…
面对侵蚀而来的紫色毒雾，夜玄压下躁动的夜狩，伸手一弹，一颗老者头颅已是托在掌心。
“火老，还要麻烦你老人家出手一次。”
九阶御兽师火陇缓缓睁眼，老眸扫视一圈四周，目光在那片铺天盖地的紫毒停留一瞬。
他闭上眼，没有耽搁，甲级御兽师天赋焚妖炉已是瞬间开启！
一团火光从火陇头中涌出，如同一轮烈日在十度空间中冉冉升起，不断扩大、膨胀。
十米。
百米。
直至恐怖的千米！
赤红色的焚妖炉如同天外陨石般横亘在银色空间，炉身烈焰翻涌，将整片十度空间映照得一片通红，如火海炼狱。
content_en:
“Bold!!!”
Liu Li shouted loudly again, "You have no dignity and have ignored the laws of the alliance time and time again. Do you really think that this alliance meeting hall is a place where you can run wild as you please?"
"First he disrespected the law enforcement elders, then he made rude remarks and blasphemed the leader of the alliance. Now, he openly slanders the alliance's top leaders!"
"According to the laws of the alliance, these few articles alone are enough to send you to the Law Enforcement Hall, destroy your Dantian, cut off the beast bond, and you will never be able to stand up again!"
Ye Xuan narrowed his eyes into thin slits and said without giving in, "Then you can try."
Liu Li stopped talking when he heard the sound, raised his foot and suddenly got a shock!
“Buzz!!!”
The senior leaders of the alliance in the hall only felt their eyes blur, and the next moment, Liu Li and Ye Xuan disappeared together.
In place, only a slightly twisted space ripple was left.
The talent of a Grade-A beast master, Ten Dimensions of Space, the talent of Elder Liu Li of the Law Enforcement Hall...
…
In the vast silver space, Ye Xuan and Liu Li appeared out of thin air.
The space is boundless, and there is a silver-white surface under the feet, like a huge mirror, reflecting the two figures.
Ye Xuan looked around, with a hint of surprise in his eyes: "Is this...the tenth dimension of the talent of a Grade A beastmaster?"
"Shengzi Ye has a keen eye and discerns the essence."
There was a certain determination in Liu Li's eyes, "I would like to see how much water you, an eighth-level beast master, have."
He raised his hand and waved, the blue light surged, and a huge figure condensed and formed in front of him.
What appeared on the scene was a giant green deer, several feet tall, with a pair of antlers reaching into the sky, like two upside-down swords, and a faint cold light glowing at the tip of the horns.
On the top of the giant deer's head, a purple-red flower bud is in bud.
The eighth-level seven-star hybrid holy beast, Mandala Deer Lord, has deep-rooted talents and giant wood armor.
Mandala Deer Lord, a kind of powerful holy beast demon pet.
The talent is deep-rooted, and as long as you step on the ground, you can obtain a steady stream of pure spiritual power to repair yourself.
The hybrid talent of giant wood armor gives it unparalleled defensive capabilities.
"Shengzi Ye, you just uttered arrogant words in the main hall. Now in this ten-dimensional space, your realm is suppressed. I want to see how long you can continue to be arrogant."
Liu Li raised his hand and patted Mandala Deer Lord. Deer Lord had a clear understanding, and the purple-red buds on his head suddenly bloomed!
“Buzz!!!”
The buds stretch out layer by layer, like a blooming magical lotus, and a large amount of thick purple mist spurts out from it.
The mist rolled and surged like a living thing, rushing toward Ye Xuan overwhelmingly!
As the mist passed by, the silver-white space was dyed with a layer of lavender, and a sweet and dangerous atmosphere filled the air.
Beast Technique: Anesthesia.
The ten-dimensional space is sealed and difficult to break, and the fog has nowhere to dissipate.
The enemies trapped inside will be eaten away bit by bit...
Facing the eroding purple poisonous mist, Ye Xuan suppressed the restless Ye Shou, stretched out his hand, and an old man's head was held in his palm.
"Old Huo, I need to trouble you to take action once more."
The ninth-level beast control master Huo Long slowly opened his eyes, his old eyes scanned the surrounding area, and his eyes stayed for a moment on the overwhelming purple poison.
He closed his eyes and without any delay, the Demon Burning Furnace with the talent of a Grade-A Beast Controller was instantly activated!
“Buzz!!!”
A ball of fire gushes out from the fire head, like a scorching sun rising slowly in the ten-dimensional space, constantly expanding and expanding.
Ten meters.
100 meters.
Until the terrifying thousand meters!
The crimson demon-burning furnace lay across the silver space like a meteorite from the sky. The flames of the furnace were surging, and the entire ten-dimensional space was illuminated red, like a sea of ​​fire and purgatory.
